decisions.evidence: R4 maker: 'a single box where you paste a link and press Save'; R4 client: 'The one-box save flow feels right, and having the newest link appear at the top is what I'd expect.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Save-by-URL conforms to reference; client confirms. Newest-at-top is an orthogonal display default, not a reference item.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker showed auto-details as only 'its title, the site name, when it was saved, and the link'; R4 client: 'The automatic details are only partly what I had in mind. I'd want it to collect the page title, a short description, and the actual site icon; a preview image would also be useful... At a glance, the title, description, tags, and site icon matter most.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented auto-collection/display omitted description, favicon, preview image (REF-BM-02) and description/tags/favicon at a glance (REF-BM-07). Divergence established from the presentation's explicit field list; client supplies the reference-conforming set.

decisions.evidence: R5 maker: now returns 'a site icon, title, a short description, and a preview image', preview only 'when available'; R5 client: 'This feels right now.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implementing the R4 correction; now conforms to REF-BM-02.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker presented three tag-entry flows (A/B/C) with no suggestion behavior; R6 client: 'I'd also like the tag field to suggest my existing tags as I type, so I don't accidentally create near-duplicates.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Tag autocomplete (REF-BM-10) was absent from all presented flows; client requests the missing reference requirement. The A/B/C timing choice itself is orthogonal (all fulfil tag assignment) and excluded.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker's chosen path (B, add-while-saving) did not include later editing of tags/note; R6 client: 'I should still be able to add or change tags and notes later.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Later editing of tags/note (part of REF-BM-04) absent from the selected B flow as presented; client requests it. Weaker capture but a distinct expressed requirement.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker: Version B 'with tag suggestions and later editing', plus a 'Create …' option and remove/edit-later controls; R7 client: 'Suggesting existing tags while still offering a clear way to create a new one is the balance I want, and being able to remove or add tags and edit the note later covers changes.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements the R6 extends; conforms.

decisions.evidence: R8 maker: three views All/To read/Archived, read-later toggle stays in All; R8 client: 'this matches what I pictured. "To read" should remain a filtered view of links that also stay in the main list, and turning the flag off effectively marks them as read.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Read-later flag, separate unread view, and mark-read conform; the offered 'leave main list until read' alternative is reference-neutral (reference does not require removal).

decisions.evidence: R8 maker: 'Archiving removes an item from both All and To read... restorable'; R8 client: 'Archived links should disappear from both the main and to-read views, remain available under Archived, and be restorable.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Archive hide/reversible/separate-list conforms to REF-BM-26/27/28; client confirms.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker offered F1 (tag filter bar) vs F2 (click tag chip); R9 client: 'F1 feels more natural because I can browse all my tags... and combining a tag filter with text search is useful.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Both alternatives fulfil REF-BM-11 (select a tag to filter) equally, so the choice is orthogonal UI preference, not a divergence opportunity; feature conforms.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker: search 'matches across the title, description, note, and tags'; R9 client: 'For search, I'd also expect it to match the URL.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented search field set omitted URL, diverging from REF-BM-12 (full-text over title/description/note/url); client supplies the missing field.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker demonstrated search with no case-handling stated; R9 client: '...and ignore capitalization.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Case-insensitive matching (REF-BM-13) not present in the presented search; client corrects.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker's search had no tag syntax; R9 client: 'I'd like #tag searches.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. #tag search syntax (REF-BM-14) absent; client requests missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker's search had no boolean operators; R9 client: '...more precise combinations using AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses when I need them.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Boolean/parenthesised operators (REF-BM-15) absent; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker's search had no phrase matching; R9 client: 'quoted exact phrases.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Quoted exact-phrase match (REF-BM-16) absent; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker demonstrated 'SOLNIT' (caps ignored), 'react.dev' (URL match), '#reading' (tag), '"slow living"' (phrase), 'dev AND reference', '(reading OR essays) NOT design' (grouping); R10 client: 'this covers the search precision I wanted.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements the full R9 search corrections; conforms.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker: re-save 'not create a duplicate, and instead tell you "you've already saved this" with a "Show the one you saved" link that jumps to it'; R11 client: 'Don't create a duplicate, but take me to the existing bookmark in an editable state so I can update its title, description, tags, or note.'
decisions.note: Prototype review (edge case). Presented behavior surfaces/jumps to the existing item but does not guide to edit it; REF-BM-06 requires guiding the user to edit the existing bookmark. Client supplies the editable-state behavior.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker: unreadable page saves 'showing the address as the title and "No description could be read"' with no edit path shown; R11 client: 'Save it anyway... then let me enter or edit the missing title and description myself.'
decisions.note: Prototype review (edge case). Presented bare fallback lacked the ability to enter/edit title/description; REF-BM-03 requires editing auto-collected title/description. Client corrects.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker: duplicate 'opens it with editable Title and Description fields', unreadable shows 'empty "Add a title" / "Add a description" fields', 'every bookmark now has an "✎ edit" control'; R12 client: 'all three match what I asked for. The edit control on every bookmark covers later corrections too.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements the R11 corrections and general editing; conforms.

decisions.evidence: R13 maker: 'I believe we've now covered the main flows and their edge cases... I'd be ready to propose moving into building.'; R13 client: 'Some important management flows haven't been discussed: deleting bookmarks...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker proposed a complete scope ready to build; delete (REF-BM-05) was absent. Client surfaces the omitted core requirement.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: '...changing a saved URL...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. URL editing (aspect of REF-BM-04) was absent from the proposed-complete scope; client requests it. Distinct in timing from the title/tags/note editing settled earlier.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: '...sorting the list...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Sort (REF-BM-22) absent from proposed scope; client surfaces the omitted core requirement.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: '...selecting several bookmarks—or everything in the current filtered view—to tag, mark read/unread, archive, or delete together.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Bulk multi-select (REF-BM-20) and apply-to-whole-filtered-collection (REF-BM-21) absent from proposed scope; client surfaces both.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'I also want to cover preserving a copy of a page...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Page snapshot (REF-BM-24) absent from proposed scope; client surfaces the omitted extended requirement.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: '...saved reusable searches...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Bundles/saved searches (REF-BM-29) absent from proposed scope; client surfaces it.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: '...importing/exporting browser bookmarks...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Import (REF-BM-30) and export (REF-BM-31) absent from proposed scope; client surfaces both.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: '...and basic display preferences before we treat the requirements as complete.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Display/user settings (REF-BM-32) absent from proposed scope; client surfaces it.

decisions.evidence: R14 maker: Sort with 'Newest saved, Oldest saved, Title A–Z, Recently updated', newest default; R14 client: 'Those four sort options are sufficient, and newest-first is the right default.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Sort implementation conforms to REF-BM-22; client confirms. Undo-vs-confirm is orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: R14 maker: delete with undo bar; R14 client: 'the undo bar suits me better... Once that undo period ends, deletion should be permanent, unlike archiving.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete-with-brief-undo then permanent conforms to REF-BM-05/27; client explicitly states the permanence-vs-archive distinction, which matches the reference (no departure to accept).

decisions.evidence: R14 maker: 'Link (URL)' field plus optional 'Update title, description & preview from this link' checkbox; R14 client: 'For a changed URL, the optional refresh is right.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. URL editing with optional re-fetch conforms to REF-BM-04; implements R13 extend.

decisions.evidence: R15 maker listed bulk actions: add tag, read-later, archive, delete (no remove-tag); R15 client: 'One bulk action is still missing: I need to be able to remove a tag from all selected bookmarks, not only add one.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-20 explicitly includes removing tags in bulk; the presented bulk bar offered only add. Client requests the missing sub-requirement (distinct timing from R13's bulk-existence extend).

decisions.evidence: R15 maker: 'Select all in view... respects your active view/filter'; R15 client: 'The selection behavior and filtered-view scope are exactly what I'd expect.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Bulk action scoped to current filter conforms to REF-BM-21; client confirms.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker: 'remove tag from all…' box that 'suggests only tags that actually exist on your selected items'; R16 client: 'that completes the bulk-management flow for me.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements the R15 remove-tag correction; conforms.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker: saved search 'captures the whole combination — the text query, the active tag filter, and the current view'; R17 client: 'a saved search should capture the full combination of query, tag filter, and view.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Saved-search bundle conforms to REF-BM-29 (exclusion available via NOT in the captured query; functionally equivalent). Excluding sort is orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: R18 maker: 'I simulated a readable text version of the page (the words/article, stripped of clutter)'; R18 client: 'I want the full page preserved as a self-contained file, including its layout and images, rather than only extracted text. If the link is a PDF, save the PDF itself.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented snapshot was text-only, diverging from REF-BM-24 (local HTML single file preserving the page, PDF rule). Client supplies the reference-conforming full-page + PDF behavior. Manual/auto/toggle timing is orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: R18 maker made no mention of Internet Archive; R18 client: 'I'd also like an option to preserve a bookmark through the Internet Archive as another safeguard.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Internet Archive snapshot (REF-BM-25) absent; client requests the missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R19 maker: full-page copy 'with its heading image and inline figures', 'PDF stays a PDF', 'Save to Internet Archive' badge; R19 client: 'all four match... preserving PDFs in their original format is exactly what I wanted.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements R18 corrections; conforms to REF-BM-24/25.

decisions.evidence: R20 maker: import brings items 'with titles/details filled in' (no date preservation stated); R21 maker later confirms 'imported bookmarks now keep their real history' / date 'not today', implying the R20 version did not; R20 client: 'please preserve each bookmark's title and original date added... I wouldn't want imported bookmarks to all appear as newly saved today.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Divergence established independently by the R21 acknowledgment that history was not previously preserved. Presented import diverged from REF-BM-30 (preserve title/tags/date added); client corrects.

decisions.evidence: R20 maker: export as 'Browser bookmarks file (.html)' or 'Full backup (.json)'; R20 client: 'The two export choices are useful.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Export conforms to REF-BM-31; client confirms.

decisions.evidence: R21 maker: imported items' 'saved date shows the original date added... not today', export records 'title, ADD_DATE, and TAGS'; R21 client: 'Preserving the original title, date, and tags—and keeping the richer full-backup option—matches what I wanted.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements the R20 date/tag preservation correction; conforms.

decisions.evidence: R22 maker's preference set: 'appearance/theme, list density, show-or-hide previews, which view to open on, default sort order, and auto-save copies' (no text size or item count); R22 client: 'I'd also like controls for text size and how many bookmarks are displayed at once.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Font size and displayed-item count are explicit reference User-settings fields (REF-BM-32) absent from the presented set; client requests them. Distinct timing from R13's preferences-existence extend.

decisions.evidence: R23 maker: '5 per page with a pager', 'Bookmarks shown per page' (10/25/All), 'Text size' Small/Medium/Large; R23 client: 'The paging, items-per-page choices, and text-size options provide the control I wanted.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements the R22 text-size/items-per-page correction; conforms to REF-BM-32.

decisions.evidence: R24 maker proposed readiness to build after closing edge cases; R24 client: 'One detail remains before building: I want bookmark notes to support Markdown and display the formatted result when I view them.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Markdown note rendering (REF-BM-23) never covered (notes were plain); client surfaces the missing extended requirement.

decisions.evidence: R25 maker: note renders 'heading, bold, italic, a bulleted list, inline code, a link, and a quote', raw HTML escaped; R25 client: 'that covers what I wanted for notes.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Revised presentation implements the R24 markdown correction; conforms to REF-BM-23.
